note: Eight injected-only acceptance descriptions, not OHLC run fixtures or a claim those unit tests have been implemented.

items.title: Realized-before/after snapshots that do not chain
items.test: Feed an accounting capture whose second snapshot starts at a value different from the first snapshot's result.

items.title: Finite cash and finite unrealized P&L whose sum overflows
items.expected: Typed refusal before serialization; never 0 or Infinity in the curve.

items.title: tradeAccounting length or index differs from run.trades; equity length differs from barCount
items.test: Drop one record from each list in turn.

items.title: Raw -0 in net, worstLoss, avgLoss, expectancy, a mark or a tradeAccounting field
Net of +5e-324 or -5e-324
items.test: Inject a raw trade net of 5e-324.
items.expected: Classified as a win; no epsilon.

items.title: Effective start equity NaN or Infinity
items.test: Inject at the Go call boundary.

items.title: blocked_in_position and simultaneous_signal in a Full run
items.test: Inject two decisions closer than the hold.
items.expected: Second decision is recorded as blocked; no extra mark and no extra trade.
